Engineers are responsible for end-to-end projects from training and productionizing classifiers to identify high-intent users, personalizing value discovery, shipping contextual onboarding experiments, or wiring new AI capabilities into measurable adoption and revenue outcomes. Growth at Perplexity goes beyond incremental funnel optimization. The team sits close to the core product - we translate behavioral signals, model outputs, and fast experimentation into durable product surfaces used across consumer and enterprise workflows. You'll move fast, run many experiments in parallel, and own the outcome end-to-end. Tech Stack: TypeScript | Next.js | React | Python | PostgreSQL | Eppo | AWS WHY PERPLEXITY IS DIFFERENT - Craftsmanship. We build high quality, tasteful products targeting both the AI native and AI curious. - Ownership. You identify the problem, design the solution and ship it. - Entrepreneurship. We think like founders, act with urgency, and hustle to deliver for each other and our users. - Scholarship. Work among highly talented peers, pursuing knowledge and truth, upleveling ourselves, our teams, and our products. - Partnership. We amplify each others' strengths, break down silos, and give selflessly to help our colleagues deliver excellence. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design, build, and own growth surfaces across the full funnel — activation, onboarding, SEO, lifecycle, conversion, retention, and paid upgrade moments — for Computer and every Perplexity product. - Lead experiments end-to-end, from hypothesis and instrumentation through implementation, analysis, and rollout, shipping many in parallel and learning quickly from each. - Build applied AI systems that power growth: classifiers for high-intent segments, personalization for value discovery, and AI-driven onboarding and recommendation surfaces. - Launch vertical-specific experiences (e.g., students, enterprise organizations) that connect new AI capabilities to measurable adoption and revenue outcomes. - Hill-climb on the metrics that matter: activation rate, paid conversion, retention, and habit formation, instrumented with clean data and trustworthy experiment readouts. - Partner closely with Product, Design, Data Science, Monetization, Marketing, and Applied AI to translate behavioral signals and model outputs into durable product surfaces. As a Facilities Operations Technician at SpaceXAI, you'll dive in, operating and maintaining the critical facility systems that power our supercomputing data centers. Working hands-on with MEP systems, you’ll tackle maintenance, operations, and repairs, ensuring peak performance and reliability. Expect to troubleshoot complex issues, streamline processes, and collaborate with teams to keep our infrastructure running smoothly, directly supporting SpaceXAI's mission to accelerate human scientific discovery through AI.

Facilities Operations Technician

Sr Facilities Operations Technician
: Perform advanced maintenance and troubleshooting of critical data center systems like HVAC, power, and environmental controls, while mentoring junior technicians to ensure operational reliability.
Facilities Operations Lead
: Oversee the maintenance and optimization of critical data center infrastructure, including power, cooling, and environmental systems, while leading a team of technicians to ensure operational reliability and efficiency.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Responsible for MEP Infrastructure site safety and environmental compliance, ensuring the sites align with all local and regional health and safety requirements.

Experience with writing and executing MOPs, SOPs, EOPs.

Develop and implement energy monitoring metrics.

Experience and knowledge of all critical systems documentation including Plans, Procedures, and Operations Manuals.
Experience and knowledge of Building and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems and Operations.
Strong troubleshooting skills.
Experience with PLC-based control systems and/or with Building Management Systems (Client).
Excellent written and verbal communication and technical writing skills in English.
Physical Requirements:
Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.
Ability to utilize hand tools and power tools as needed.
Work is often performed in tight quarters, and physical dexterity is necessary to perform job functions.
Ability to lift up to 35 lbs. unassisted.
Comfortable working at elevated heights (up to 100 feet) with appropriate safety gear.
Comfortable working in extreme outdoor environments—heat, cold, rain, etc.
Comfortable working in an environment requiring exposure to fumes, odors, and noise.

Use proprietary software to provide labels, annotations, recordings, and inputs on projects involving multilingual audio clips, voice recordings, speech samples, and auditory elements in various languages.

Deep understanding and taste of what good/useful Audio data is.
Strong command of advanced transcription and annotation practices, including handling disfluencies, accents, and prosodic features (intonation, stress, rhythm, emotion, etc) with high consistency and accuracy.
Background in linguistics (e.g., phonetics, phonology, sociolinguistics), speech sciences, cognitive science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with demonstrated ability to analyze accent variation, pronunciation differences, and multilingual speech patterns.

jobs.description: Data Analyst – Assurance & Continuous Monitoring Description - Job Summary •The Data Analyst – Trade Compliance Assurance serves as the analytics and data enablement lead for the Trade Compliance Assurance function. This role is responsible for leveraging enterprise data, analytics, automation, and reporting capabilities to strengthen the effectiveness of the Trade Compliance Internal Control Program, enhance risk visibility, and support continuous monitoring initiatives. The role will play a key part in advancing the Trade Compliance Assurance program from traditional periodic assessments to a more data-driven, continuous-monitoring approach by increasing the use of analytics, automation, and risk intelligence across the organization. This includes supporting the design and enhancement of monitoring mechanisms that provide insight into control performance, identify recurring errors and trends, and drive continuous improvement of the Trade Compliance control environment. Responsibilities Data Analytics & Insights Analyze operational data to identify errors, anomalies, trends, and emerging risks, and develop analytical models and exception reporting that enable proactive issue detection, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of trade-related internal controls. Deliver actionable insights that support risk-based decision-making and continuous improvement. Continuous Monitoring & Internal Controls Design and maintain analytics-driven monitoring of key Trade Compliance controls. Develop dashboards, KPIs, KRIs, and key control indicators (KCIs) to measure control effectiveness and compliance performance. Identify control exceptions, recurring issues, and opportunities to strengthen the internal control environment. Data Management & Reporting Leverage enterprise data sources, including FDL, to create scalable reporting and monitoring solutions. Apply data modeling, database, and data quality principles to ensure reliable and accurate analytics. Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and management reporting. Automation & Process Improvement Automate reporting, monitoring, and exception detection processes to increase efficiency and coverage. Implement analytics and workflow solutions that reduce manual effort and improve data-driven oversight. Stakeholder Collaboration Partner with Assurance, control owners, business teams, and IT to deliver analytical solutions. Translate business requirements into data-driven insights and technical solutions. Promote adoption of analytics and continuous monitoring practices across the Trade Compliance organization. Education & Experience Recommended Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field. 8+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, data management, or related analytical functions. Experience working with enterprise data platforms, data warehouses, and large-scale transactional datasets. Strong experience leveraging FDL and other enterprise data repositories to develop reporting, monitoring, and analytical solutions. Demonstrated understanding of database structures, relational database concepts, data modeling, data architecture, and data governance principles. Experience developing dashboards, scorecards, and visualization solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools. Experience writing and optimizing SQL queries and working with complex data relationships across multiple systems. Experience implementing data quality controls, data validation, reconciliation, and data integrity checks. Proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable analytics solutions and actionable insights. Strong stakeholder management skills with experience partnering across business, technical, and operational teams. Preferred Experience (Nice to Have) Experience supporting Internal Audit, Assurance, Risk Management, Compliance, or Governance organizations. Knowledge of Trade Compliance, Customs, Export Controls, or other regulatory environments. Experience developing exception-based monitoring, anomaly detection, or risk intelligence solutions. Knowledge & Skills echnical Skills Advanced SQL querying and data extraction. Data modeling and analytical dataset development. Dashboard and visualization development using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools. Data analysis of large and complex datasets. Database analysis and interpretation of relational data structures. Data validation, reconciliation, and quality analysis. Process automation using Power Automate, Python, or similar technologies. Development of monitoring, exception reporting, and performance measurement solutions. Analytical Skills Identify patterns, anomalies, and emerging risks from large datasets. Translate data into actionable business insights and recommendations. Perform root-cause analysis and problem resolution. Design metrics, KPIs, KRIs, and monitoring indicators. Evaluate data quality and assess the reliability of data sources. Business & Communication Skills Translate business requirements into analytical and technical solutions. Communicate complex analytical findings to technical and non-technical audiences. Collaborate effectively with business, operational, technology, and assurance stakeholders. Influence decision-making through data-driven insights. Manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast-paced environment. Leadership & Professional Skills Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities. Continuous improvement and innovation mindset. Ability to drive adoption of analytics and data-driven practices. Self-starter with strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities. Capability to mentor others and promote data literacy across the organization. Nice-to-Have Skills Trade Compliance analytics. Internal controls monitoring and control effectiveness testing. Risk analytics and continuous monitoring. SAP S/4HANA, ERP data analysis, and enterprise data ecosystems. Experience supporting assurance, audit, compliance, or governance programs. Impact & Scope • Provides analytics leadership for the Trade Compliance Assurance function by developing data-driven monitoring, reporting, and automation solutions that improve error detection, control performance visibility, risk identification, and continuous improvement of the Internal Control Program. Leverages enterprise data sources, including FDL, to enable scalable monitoring and actionable insights across global Trade Compliance operations. Complexity • Operates in a highly complex environment involving large, diverse, and interconnected datasets across multiple enterprise systems and data sources. The role requires the ability to understand business processes, data structures, internal controls, and reporting requirements; integrate data from various platforms, including FDL; and translate complex business challenges into scalable analytics, monitoring, and automation solutions. Success requires balancing technical expertise, analytical problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement to drive improvements in control effectiveness, risk visibility, and continuous monitoring capabilities. . jobs.description: Are you a developer advocate? A builder passionate about incredible software? Are you excited by AI-assisted development, fast feedback loops, and tools that make hard things easy? We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help us build the future of how Amazon's networking OS is tested and released. Join us! Our team delivers software services and infrastructure for the Amazon networking OS. We are a builder tools team: we build tools for other builders. You will build the next generation of our testing ecosystem, one that leverages AI tooling, fast builds, and virtualization to let our builders release the networking OS faster and with more confidence. Instead of waiting on hardware labs and slow validation cycles, builders will get rapid, trustworthy signal from virtualized network topologies, intelligent test selection, and AI-assisted workflows that catch problems earlier and explain them better. Our goal is improving the developer experience by providing world-class tooling that empowers, enables, and fosters ideas. We champion great engineering practices: we make the right things common, common things easy, and ensure uncommon things are possible. We craft great tools that are simple, intuitive, reliable, and feel nice to use. We reduce friction and increase output for the same input. Above all, customers come to us because we are a strong, high-quality, and dependable engineering org. You will join us to influence, innovate, and raise the bar in this mission. Our team is seeking a Software Development Engineer to support the following: - Design and build core components of our testing ecosystem: virtualized network device environments, fast incremental build systems, and AI-powered developer tooling - Own features end to end, from design through deployment and operation - Work directly with networking OS builders to understand their release pain points and turn them into tooling that removes friction - Raise the bar on quality, agility, predictability, and consistency across the developer experience Key job responsibilities You will solve complex and ambiguous problems, efficiently and with high quality. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the definition, vision, design, roadmap, development, and operationalization of customer-facing services. You will be given an outcome and the freedom to set the direction based on data driven decisions. You will be part of a startup with the backing of a large company. You will be a core voice in how this team runs. You will be part of the key decisions: what we build, how we build it, and who joins us. You will help shape the team vision and then make it real, and you will interview and hire for both our team and the wider org. You will also mentor the next generation of software engineers, builders with strong architectural judgment who are amplified by AI. Your job is to help them move fast with AI while keeping the rigor that great systems demand. A day in the life Your day starts with the team, not a ticket queue. We plan together, unblock each other fast, and keep meetings light so builders spend their time building. You might spend the morning pairing with an AI agent on a new feature for our virtualized test environments, then jump into a design review for the next piece of our build acceleration work. After lunch you demo what you shipped to the networking OS engineers who use it, hear what still slows them down, and turn that friction into the next thing on the roadmap. We are a tools team, so our customers sit one door down. Feedback loops are measured in hours, not quarters. You will see your work land in another builder's hands the same week you ship it, and you will feel the difference when a release that used to take days of validation clears in minutes. When you hit something ambiguous, and you will, the team is around you: whiteboard it, prototype it, decide with data, and move. About the team We serve many customers and play a critical multiplying role across Networking services. We run very lean and scale with the business, without repeated technical or operational burden. We build the platform that validates the Amazon networking OS: the networking engineers write the tests, and we own the ecosystem that builds, runs, and reports them, from CI/CD pipelines to virtualized network environments to AI-powered tooling. We use Rust, Go, and Python (and many other things) in NAWS, with React on the front end. We own and support services across four verticals: Product – We own solutions that provide visibility into business-driving metrics, aggregate information, trigger actions, and help leaders manage this domain. Build and release – We own the CI/CD charter. We push commits through pipelines that compile binaries, build images and debug symbols, run multiple stages of validation, and ship updates to millions of devices across the Amazon network. We aim to simplify and shorten the path from commit to release. Validation and qualification – Builders use our testing frameworks to validate the OS. We own the tooling for unit, integration, functional, and system testing, plus static analysis (the builders own the tests). This is where our next-generation work lives: virtualized network topologies, AI-assisted testing, and faster feedback loops that raise quality while cutting release time. Infrastructure – We own and support data center labs with tooling that manages inventory, reservations, capacity auto-scaling, provisioning, recovery, and sanity checks. This is the underlying infrastructure of the ecosystem.

jobs.description: ABOUT SUNO We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Social Media Community Manager to be the voice of Suno across our social platforms and the daily connective tissue between our fans, creators, and brand. This is a full time role reporting to the Director of Social Media, and it sits at the heart of how Suno shows up in culture—shaping the tone, energy, and relationships that turn casual listeners into passionate advocates. In this role, you’ll live inside our comments, DMs, replies, and community spaces—engaging with Suno’s audience in a way that feels human, witty, and unmistakably on-brand. You’ll partner closely with the social, brand, and content teams to surface cultural moments, amplify creators, and translate community signal into insight that shapes how we talk and what we make. You’ll help build a community that feels alive, inclusive, and creatively inspired. This is a role for someone who genuinely loves the internet—who can spot a meme before it peaks, write a reply that earns a screenshot, and spark conversations that make people feel seen. You understand the rhythm of platforms like TikTok, Instagram, X, and Reddit, and you move with the speed and fluency that real-time community work demands. You’re equally comfortable celebrating a creator’s moment, defusing a tense thread, and turning a random comment into a reason for a thousand more. Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/D0jCWAkn2JR4Kzik WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own day-to-day community engagement across Suno’s social channels (TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube, Reddit, and emerging platforms), responding to comments, DMs, and mentions in a voice that is distinctly Suno. - Build genuine relationships with Suno creators and superfans—celebrating their work, surfacing their songs, and helping them feel recognized as part of the Suno story. - Spot cultural moments, memes, and trends in real time and partner with the social team to jump on them quickly with on-brand, high-quality responses. - Moderate community spaces (Discord, Reddit, comments sections) with care and good judgment—keeping conversations healthy, welcoming, and aligned with our community guidelines. - Act as the first line of listening for the brand—tracking sentiment, surfacing emerging themes, and escalating issues, bugs, or sensitive conversations to the appropriate teams. - Drive a proactive social listening practice—monitoring conversations across owned channels, broader social platforms, and creator communities to identify recurring themes, sentiment shifts, white-space opportunities, and early signals of issues. - Translate those themes into clear, prioritized actions: content ideas for the social team, talking points for brand and PR, product feedback for the Suno team, creator outreach opportunities, and adjustments to community strategy. jobs.description: Join the Technical Fellow Office to solve hard, ambiguous problems, set the bar for technical judgment, and shape how the broader engineering organization builds — across teams and beyond our immediate department. If you want to work where cutting-edge AI meets production-grade engineering — and influence how an entire division builds — this is that role. Run design reviews that change outcomes, not just document them. Drive adoption : Get platforms and tooling used by teams outside your own. Track the frontier : Spend real time outward — evaluating emerging models, harnesses, and techniques; maintaining a network of peers; bringing back a point of view on what matters and what doesn't.
